claims.full_statement: Each local component certificate is indexed by one actual bearer, interval, signature, realization map, transition system, admitted input family and claimed invariant; it makes no claim about a later coupled instance.
claims.domain: Two selected producer/consumer component certificates on one declared application with separately recorded local input contracts.
all_premises: actual bearer and interval for each component
claims.proof_or_source: Typed premise package distilled from the effective R171 certificate boundary.
claims.counterexample: TE-QC-01 preserves both standalone certificates while a connector supplies unadmitted inputs.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Prevents the local certificates from silently changing bearers, inputs or time when connected.

claims.full_statement: Compat_gamma jointly requires common actual binding, initial agreement, preservation of the locally certified admitted-input families, projection/refinement of every joint transition to both certified local transitions, and preservation of connector agreement.
claims.domain: One actual P/I/K/D, two selected component transition systems, one actual connector gamma and one joint-step convention.
all_premises: joint initials in local invariants and J_gamma
connector-induced inputs stay inside both certified input families
joint transitions project to local certified transitions
claims.proof_or_source: Declared conjunctive interface contract; Theorem R172-A uses it.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Makes the omitted premise in component composition explicit.

claims.full_statement: If both local invariants are valid under their admitted inputs and Compat_gamma holds, then the joint set S_gamma=S_B x S_A intersect J_gamma is invariant under every admitted joint transition.
claims.domain: Finite or infinite deterministic/nondeterministic transition systems satisfying the exact contract; finite path induction.
claims.proof_or_source: Arbitrary-successor argument plus induction on joint path length; standard invariant composition reasoning.
claims.counterexample: Without admitted-input preservation, TE-QC-01 reaches (1,1) outside S_1 x S_2.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Separates a valid composition theorem from the false shortcut local closure implies joint closure.

claims.full_statement: Two Boolean components with x_i'=u_i and standalone input contract u_i=0 preserve S_i={0}; the connector u_1=1-x_2,u_2=1-x_1 sends (0,0) to (1,1), so local certificates alone do not entail joint closure.
claims.proof_or_source: Direct exact evaluation, checked by verify_interface_action.py.
claims.counterexample: The model itself is the counterexample to the composition shortcut.
claims.thought_experiment_role: TE-QC-01 acceptance witness; no originality claim.

claims.full_statement: LiveUse_gamma(k,a|W) requires an actual connector occurrence, baseline consumer use, an admissible mediator/cut contrast changing a before compensation under fixed eligible background, passed realization/fidelity/locality assumptions, and no report-defined role.
claims.domain: One actual P/I/K/D, selected k/gamma/a occurrences, predeclared intervention family W and pre-compensation interval.
claims.proof_or_source: Refinement of R166 W3-W5 into a cross-interface selected relation.
claims.counterexample: Replay/bypass matches the baseline but lacks the selected mediator dependence.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Specifies what changes between live and replay cases.

claims.full_statement: On the two-model class L: k=b,a=k,r=ell(b) and Q: k=b,a=v,r=ell(b), with baseline v=b, the natural tuple (b,k,a,r) is identical while do(k=1-b) changes a only in L; therefore baseline action/report does not identify LiveUse_gamma.
claims.domain: Binary deterministic structural models with fixed exogenous replay tape and admissible mediator intervention.
claims.proof_or_source: Exact two-model enumeration for b in {0,1}.
claims.counterexample: The paired models are the equal-observation/different-target witness.
claims.thought_experiment_role: TE-QC-02 functional/organizational distinction; not empirical evidence.

claims.full_statement: On one common actual token, a witnessed installed body-frame relation, a valid interface-composition instance and LiveUse_gamma jointly establish a selected online body-frame-to-action relation; no report or phenomenal label is part of the relation.
claims.domain: One actual P/I/K/D, one installed body-frame relation, one compatible connector and one declared intervention family.
claims.proof_or_source: Conjunctive packaging on identical bearer/time/signature bindings; no reverse implication.
claims.counterexample: The replay/bypass member of TE-QC-02 can match baseline action and report while failing LiveUse_gamma.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Supplies the selected K-relation needed for the later same-instance C1 transport.

claims.full_statement: If theta_EBA=Anchor AND Bind AND Compat_gamma AND LiveUse_gamma is independently grounded as a K-relation on one actual P/I/K/D and the same instance satisfies C1, then theta_EBA holds of the h-images inside Phi; familiar felt mineness still requires independent B_min/F_O/F_A.
claims.domain: One common actual C1 instance and one selected grounded online body-action relation.
claims.proof_or_source: Conjoin grounded K-relations and apply ordinary isomorphism preservation on the identical P/I/K/D/Phi/h instance; retain the R157 semantic countermodel.
claims.counterexample: Changing the external L-label while holding every K-fact fixed blocks unique familiar-mineness naming.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Provides the positive experience-internal explanation without an extra owner.

claims.full_statement: Biological and artificial processes may be compared on theta_EBA only after independent actual realization, interface, live-use and common-signature obligations are met; matched output/report does not establish the relation, and shared relation does not establish complete-organizational or experiential identity.
claims.domain: Named biological/artificial actual tokens and their separately grounded selected relations.
claims.proof_or_source: Direct scope consequence of the non-identification witness and selected-coordinate C1 application.
claims.counterexample: Live and replay models match baseline output/report while differing in theta_EBA's LiveUse conjunct.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Explains what the UCT comparison adds beyond output matching without declaring consciousness status.
